about: Measured by capture/linux_capture.py (the memory scene) and summarized by tools/read_app_memory.mjs: the Linux desktop app with the model loaded, then checking one long text.

basis.where: the Linux build of the app in a container on a virtual display, software rendering, no GPU, six processor cores available to the container; the app is not pinned to one core, so the processor figure is what it used, not a limit
basis.counters: /proc/<pid>/status VmRSS (resident now), VmHWM (resident at its peak), RssAnon (the private part), sampled every 100 ms; processor time from /proc/<pid>/stat

processor.window: the 12 s from pressing Check, which includes the seconds after the reading, when the app is idle
